## Checkpoint table on PostgreSQL and MySQL

A maintenance release: no API change, and nothing to migrate coming from 1.0.1.

### Fixed
- **`createTableIfMissing()` on PostgreSQL and MySQL.** `JdbcCheckpointStore.createTableIfMissing()` declared the payload column as `CLOB`, a type neither PostgreSQL nor MySQL has, so the call failed on both. The column is now `TEXT` on PostgreSQL, `LONGTEXT` on MySQL and MariaDB, and `CLOB` elsewhere.

If you created the `agent_checkpoint` table yourself with a migration, nothing changes: the store reads and writes the payload as a string either way.

The fix was checked by hand against PostgreSQL 16 and MySQL 8.0. The automated tests still run on H2 only.

### Docs
- [Validation](https://datallmhub.github.io/agentflow4j/validation/): every guarantee, the test behind it, and what that test does not prove.

### Install
```xml
<dependency>
    <groupId>io.github.datallmhub</groupId>
    <artifactId>agentflow4j-starter</artifactId>
    <version>1.0.2</version>
</dependency>
```
